description: Ascensor El Peral, the 1902 funicular up Cerro Alegre in Valparaíso, photographed from the Paseo Yugoslavo
verification_note: Looking down the twin yellow-railed incline at a red-and-green funicular car with passengers aboard, city rooftops and a neoclassical facade below. Confirms the funicular; the Paseo Yugoslavo itself is not identifiable in frame, so the caption was narrowed.
